direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) for secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A as sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, an x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions driven by real state; 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels, one 240ms route trace on real state change; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then an Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: layered depth, brushed-silver machine forms, emerald living material flow on feasible routes, state glow on active stations, MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene to at least 70% of main and refit the reserved side zone narrower; add layered machine depth, emerald material flow along DOCK to QA to cells, and state glow on RECEIVING hold.
Remove the duplicate opening-story logo treatment from the scene corner so the required placements remain header and opening story only; use that space for 70 parts at risk.
Raise side-zone body and Source detail labels to 16px and give the three evidence rows stronger silver hierarchy so 120 versus 80 reads in three seconds.

Resolve the contradiction in the findings zone: 0 Verified facts beside Verified findings and 3 Feasible paths undermines trust; show the actual verified count or label this state Sample findings awaiting verification at 18px.
Separate provider identity readiness from the investigation evidence task under distinct headings, statuses and controls in the reserved side zone.
Add emerald flow and glow to feasible routes in the scene when findings complete, with a single 240ms trace and a static reduced-motion equivalent.

Make the scene respond to path selection: highlight only the selected route through cells and jobs in emerald with living flow, dim unselected routes to silver, and mirror the highlight bidirectionally with the side cards.
Enlarge Select this path targets and option body text to 16px minimum with a clear 2px emerald focus ring; keep one primary action in the action bar.
Add a compact persistent legend for Held, Available, At Risk and Feasible inside the scene zone so color is never the only signal.
Increase cinematic presence: turn the three stations and t1-t3 cards into a depth-layered SVG line with emerald flow from RECEIVING through CELL-MILL-1 and a progress pulse only on state change.
Clarify untracked status with a plain 16px sentence: Proposed tasks are untracked until approval; keep dashed silver borders plus PROPOSED text so meaning survives without color.
Fix the full-width progress bar on t3 so fill length matches After t2 dependency rather than implying completion; align all three bars to the same scale.

Strengthen the shock moment with a cinematic transition: animate flow stopping at CELL-MILL-2, then settle into silver cross-hatching, x marker and plain OFFLINE text; honor reduced motion by showing the final patterned state immediately.
Raise the dropdown, cell status and scenario text to 16px and enlarge the machine selector target above 36px with a visible focus ring.
Make preview versus applied state unmistakable in the scene header: use PREVIEW - WILL GO OFFLINE in the station and reserve OFFLINE alone for the applied state.
CELL-MILL-2 correctly uses hatching and OFFLINE, but the long diagonal cross lines overshoot the card; refit the x marker inside the station bounds and add the persistent legend.
Separate provider identity readiness from the Investigate source evidence task; the current side zone merges model status, sample notice and the evidence action into one block.
Fill the empty Verified findings reserved zone with a concise awaiting-investigation state at 16px so the layout does not read as unfinished.
Show the revised math in the scene: route 40 and 30 units through CELL-MILL-1 only, mark Split as constrained with pattern and text, and add emerald flow on the two feasible paths.
Raise comparison card body text to 16px and make the constrained row legible with brighter silver text over the hatching.
Keep DOES NOT MATCH and the 120 versus 80 tracks aligned inside stage bounds while widening the scene toward 70% of main.

Visually separate the coexistence story: give 3 BLOCKED prior tasks a hatched silver zone and the 3 PROPOSED replacements a distinct dashed zone, each with its own heading and count, so neither reads as overwriting the other.
Add depth and flow to the replanned line: emerald flow through CELL-MILL-1, static silver OFFLINE pattern with x marker on CELL-MILL-2, and glow on the station carrying the accepted plan.
Enlarge the blocked-task list text to 16px and show all three blocked items within the reserved zone without scrolling.
Add cinematic proof visualization: an emerald chain trace linking 01 Verify ledger to 02 Seal packet to 03 Retain checkpoint on verification, static under reduced motion, instead of three flat cards.
Reduce duplicated controls: Verify ledger appears in the side zone and the action bar; keep one primary in the action bar and make the side entry a status reference.
Raise passphrase guidance and checklist body to a full 16px/24 and keep the 70, 35h and 48h metrics as the dominant silver numerals.

Fix clipped and overlapping department titles and counts: Saw, CNC mills, CNC lathes, Heat treat, Inspection, Finishing and Assembly text collides with the x markers; enlarge each department zone, set titles at 18px and counts at 16px on separate lines.

Deliver the living cascade: show emerald material flow moving department to department, running machines with state glow and depth, then silver cross-hatching with x marker and OFFLINE as the failure wave hits; provide a static patterned reduced-motion state.
Correct inconsistent offline counts and tiny machine labels; every machine tile needs a legible OFFLINE or RUNNING word at 12px minimum with matching department totals.

Enlarge the embedded full-shop cascade visual or add a captioned zoom detail beneath it so department names, OFFLINE labels and the flow-to-offline sequence stay legible at judge reading distance; the required presentation order is retained.
Tighten the opening to one-line pitch impact: make 70 parts at risk and human authorization the largest text after the title so the stakes land before Powered by partners.
Add one concise line under the hero naming the before-and-after: certificate freeze, Meta investigation, human decision, second shock, sealed proof, reinforcing cascade legibility.
